about: Original IELTS-style Academic Writing Task 1 practice tasks written by GoNative (not official IELTS material). The data is invented for practice; charts are drawn by code from it. Reviewed by a second vendor before use.

tasks.text: The line graph shows how many people travelled to work by car, bus and bicycle in a European city between 2000 and 2020. Describe the most important trends and differences, using figures from the graph to support your description. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Commuters by mode of transport, 2000–2020
facts: Car fell from 420 thousand in 2000 to 300 thousand in 2020 (-28.6%).
Car was highest in 2005 (450 thousand) and lowest in 2020 (300 thousand).
Bus rose from 210 thousand in 2000 to 330 thousand in 2020 (+57.1%).
Bus was highest in 2020 (330 thousand) and lowest in 2000 (210 thousand).
Bicycle stayed about the same from 40 thousand in 2000 to 41 thousand in 2020 (+2.5%).
Bicycle was highest in 2005 (42 thousand) and lowest in 2000 (40 thousand).
In 2000 the highest was Car; in 2020 it was Bus.
The largest increase was in Bus (+120 thousand).
The largest decrease was in Car (−120 thousand).
Car and Bus changed places between 2015 and 2020.

Country B was highest in 2022 (90%) and lowest in 2004 (12%).

In 2004 the highest was Country A; in 2022 it was Country A.
The largest increase was in Country B (+78%).

tasks.text: The line graph shows the amount of electricity produced from coal, gas and renewable sources in one country from 2005 to 2025. Describe the most important trends and differences, using figures from the graph to support your description. Write at least 150 words.

Gas rose from 90 TWh in 2005 to 120 TWh in 2025 (+33.3%).
Gas was highest in 2020 (130 TWh) and lowest in 2005 (90 TWh).
Renewables rose from 15 TWh in 2005 to 140 TWh in 2025 (+833.3%).
Renewables was highest in 2025 (140 TWh) and lowest in 2005 (15 TWh).
In 2005 the highest was Coal; in 2025 it was Renewables.
The largest increase was in Renewables (+125 TWh).
The largest decrease was in Coal (−85 TWh).
Coal and Renewables changed places between 2020 and 2025.
Gas and Renewables changed places between 2020 and 2025.

tasks.text: The pie chart shows how an average household in one country divided its spending in 2020. Describe the most important trends and differences, using figures from the chart to support your description. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Household spending, 2020
facts: The largest share was Housing (34.5%).
The smallest share was Leisure (12%).
